problems.explain: Unrolled, the curved side is a rectangle 14 tall and as long as the circumference, 2π × 9 = 18π: 18π × 14 = 252π. The ends are two circles, πr² = 81π each, so 162π. Together 252π + 162π = 414π ≈ 3.14 × 414 = 1299.96, which is 1300.0 to 1 decimal place. (Counting one circle covers only the bottom.) So 1300.0 m².

problems.explain: A prism is the area of its end times its length. The end is a triangle with the two shorter sides at the right angle, so ½ × 5 × 12 = 30; times the length, 30 × 8.5 = 255. (5 × 12 × 8.5 = 510 is the box around it, twice as much; the longest side, 13, is not used.) So 255 m³.
